entries.keywords: python variables types string integer float input example
entries.a:
Variables store values:
name = "Rudo"
age = 12
height = 1.5
print(name, age, height)
answer = input("What is your name? ")
print("Hello", answer)

entries.keywords: python if elif else condition indentation example
python for loop while range list repeat example
entries.a:
Loops in Python:
for i in range(1, 6):
    print(i)

fruits = ["mango", "banana", "orange"]
for f in fruits:
    print(f)

n = 3
while n > 0:
    print(n)
    n -= 1

entries.a:

def area(length, width):

print(area(5, 3))   # 15

entries.a:
A number guessing game:
import random
secret = random.randint(1, 10)
guess = 0
while guess != secret:
    guess = int(input("Guess 1-10: "))
print("You got it!")

entries.keywords: variable what is variable concept box store value
entries.a: A variable is a named box that stores a value, such as score = 10. You can change what is inside: score = score + 5.

entries.keywords: debug bug error fix code not working syntax error find mistake
entries.a: To debug: 1) read the error message, it tells you the line; 2) check spelling, brackets and quotes; 3) print values to see what is happening; 4) test one small part at a time; 5) take a break and explain the code aloud. Every programmer gets bugs.

entries.keywords: data types string number boolean integer float list array
entries.a: Common data types: string (text), integer (whole number), float (decimal), boolean (true or false) and list/array (many values).

entries.keywords: git github version control commit branch push pull request
entries.a: Git records versions of your code. Basic flow: git add ., git commit -m "message", git push. A branch lets you try changes safely, and a pull request asks to merge them.

entries.keywords: learn to code roadmap path where to start free resources practice projects
entries.a: A learning path: 1) HTML and CSS, 2) JavaScript basics, 3) Python basics, 4) build small projects (quiz, calculator, to-do list), 5) put your work on GitHub. Practise a little every day and build things you care about.

entries.keywords: coding project ideas beginner what to build practice
entries.a: Beginner project ideas: a personal profile page, a times-table quiz, a tip calculator, a to-do list, a tuckshop price list, a number guessing game, a countdown to exams.
